# Support

Need help with Lody? We're here to assist. You can reach us through any of the
channels below. You do not need the app installed to contact us.

## Contact Us

- **Email:** [contact@lody.ai](mailto:contact@lody.ai?subject=Lody%20Support) — for
  support questions, bug reports, and account help. We do our best to respond promptly,
  typically within a couple of business days.
- **Discord:** [Join our community](https://discord.gg/E8mZtMu38s) — ask questions and
  get help from the team and other users.
- **X (Twitter):** [@lody_ai](https://x.com/lody_ai) — product updates and announcements.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](/docs) — guides for getting started and using Lody's features.
- [Quick Start](/docs/quickstart) — set up Lody in a few minutes.

## Account and Data

- [Account and Data Deletion](/account-deletion) — request deletion of your account and data.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](/terms)

## Reporting a Problem

When reporting a bug or issue, please include:

- A description of what happened and what you expected to happen
- The platform you were using (web, desktop, iOS, or Android)
- Steps to reproduce the problem, if known

This information helps us investigate and respond faster.
